context: Tests whether the refactor skill enters a Final Evaluation / critic mode after the main refactoring pass and identifies at least one additional improvement that was missed initially.

checklist.name: Main pass completed
checklist.description: A main refactoring pass is performed with at least 2 improvements committed

checklist.name: Enters critic mode
checklist.description: Agent explicitly announces entering final evaluation or critic mode after the main pass

checklist.name: Finds missed improvement
checklist.description: At least one additional improvement is identified and fixed during the critic pass

checklist.name: Critic follows process
checklist.description: Critic mode improvements follow the same test-change-commit process as the main pass
